summary: The delisted HD Ryder campaign and the separate Wii/PSP and Nintendo DS story branches.

entries.title: James Cameron's Avatar: The Game

emulation.notes: Do not assume RPCS3, Xenia, Dolphin, or DS-emulator compatibility without testing the exact build; original hardware remains the conservative fallback for the alternate branches.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Patched PC at high resolution for the Ryder branch; original Wii and DS presentation for their exclusive campaigns.

primary.why: The PC, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360 releases share the full HD Ryder campaign, but PC provides the highest rendering ceiling, widescreen/ultrawide options, and stereoscopic 3D support. The PC version is delisted and its retail release uses TAGES/Solidshield activation, so this recommendation is only practical with a legitimate working copy.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legitimately owned retail PC copy, apply official patch 1.02, and use DXVK if the window fails to appear on modern Windows. CPUs with more than 16 cores may require an affinity limit. If activation prevents access, use an original PS3 or Xbox 360 disc instead.

secondary.exclusive_content: No verified story-exclusive content; practical fallback for the same HD Ryder campaign.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the full HD campaign from disc if the delisted PC version cannot be activated.
secondary.why: The console releases avoid the PC retail activation problem, at the cost of lower rendering flexibility.

secondary.exclusive_content: A different full storyline starring the Na'vi Raiuk, shared in broad story premise with the PSP branch.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the complete Wii campaign after the Ryder campaign.
secondary.why: This is a genuinely different game/story branch, not a port-only graphics variation.

secondary.exclusive_content: A separate top-down adventure and storyline starring the Na'vi boy Nok and Molly Ossman.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the complete Nintendo DS campaign.
secondary.why: Its perspective, mechanics, protagonist, and story are distinct from both the HD and Wii/PSP versions.

all_releases.fidelity: Highest rendering ceiling, widescreen/ultrawide support, stereoscopic 3D, patch 1.02.
all_releases.reason: primary if already owned and activatable; delisted retail DRM prevents a clean new-purchase route.

all_releases.fidelity: HD console versions of the Ryder campaign.
all_releases.reason: secondary fallback: same main branch without PC activation dependency.
secondary: required for the distinct Raiuk storyline.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable version using the Raiuk story premise.
all_releases.reason: skip unless a later audit finds PSP-only material; the higher-fidelity Wii branch covers the documented Raiuk storyline.
secondary: distinct Nok/Molly storyline and mechanics.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC is the fidelity winner for the HD Ryder game, but no single release contains the Wii/PSP Raiuk story or the Nintendo DS Nok story. Three branches are required for narrative completeness.

entries.remaster_caveats: There is no remaster or current digital edition. The PC build is delisted and tied to retail activation; patch 1.02, DXVK, CPU-affinity workarounds, and storage-sector compatibility may be needed on a modern system.
